consequences: If -C is ever added to the diff arguments, copies must be handled again.
context: git diff runs with -M only, so git never reports a copy. node:sqlite backup() writes the backup file or throws, so the file is never missing afterwards.
decision: Remove the C (copy) status branch in packages/cli/src/git.ts and the copyFileSync fallback in packages/store-sqlite/src/migrate.ts.
title: Remove two unreachable branches found by the audit
